maria_infra: Heads up — vendor updated ETA for wave-2 H100s to Tue EOD PST. We need a plan to keep the canary run on schedule. Proposal: swap 4 canary slots from staging -> staging-2, run perf smoke Mon/Tue, then resume normal rollouts. Any blockers?
rohit_platform: Which reservations are colliding? I see two stagers overlapping with prod holdbacks.
maria_infra: Colliding reservation IDs: R-4721, R-4723, R-4890. Suggestion: temporary slot-swap script, owners can opt-in. Patch I opened: https://redwood.internal/pr/6972
maria_infra: reservation list snippet:
```
- R-4721 staging (4x H100)
- R-4723 staging-2 (2x H100)
- R-4890 prod-holdback (4x H100)
```
alex_perf: I can run a quick smoke on the perf harness but need the sample models + token seq. @maria_infra can you pin the sample prompt set? :thumbsup:
sarah_runtime: Firmware window still scheduled Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC — if we slide canary to Mon/Tue we avoid the window. Jim, any PDU concerns if we move slots earlier?
jim_ops: We have ~2.5kW headroom per rack if we shed non-critical loads. Can do Mon 22:00-02:00 PST, but need ops runbook updated. I'll add a step to the runbook.
deploy-bot: manifest v2 uploaded for staging-2: manifest-staging-2-20261121T17Z.json
rohit_platform: Quick ask — who owns the slot-swap script? I can review the PR but need an owner to merge and trigger reservations change.
maria_infra: Owner is @rohit_platform (code), @jim_ops (ops). If everyone OK, I'll mark canary slots with tag `canary-temp` and notify procurement.
alex_perf: ACK — will queue perf smoke Mon morning PST and post results here.
sarah_runtime: ACK from runtime side, will hold tuning knobs on fallback policy.
jim_ops: ACK, I'll update runbook and add the PDU checklist.
maria_infra: Thanks all — next step: rohit to merge PR, jim to confirm runbook edits, alex to run smoke. If anyone can't make the window reply here; otherwise I'll execute the slot-swap on Mon 04:00 UTC.
